# Foundry v14 Alpha 4

Alpha prerelease for **Foundry VTT v14**, bringing in the latest upstream
weapon, compendium, and credits improvements alongside v14 DV ruler and
manifest fixes.

## Changes since Alpha 3

- Enable the weapon DV ruler for linked characters when their token is
  selected, including player sheets opened outside combat.
- Declare system document types in `system.json` instead of the deprecated
  `template.json`, removing its startup warning.
- Automatically add ammo to a weapon's allowed installable types when Ranged
  Weapon is ticked.
- Label opened compendiums with their pack folder or source package.
- Add a generated Credits journal compendium built from `CREDITS.md`.
- Fix an error when uninstalling upgrades from items in the world item list.
- Update translations and the shared build system.
- Add browser coverage for the actor document browser, compendium source
  labels, ranged-weapon ammo, and world-item upgrade removal.

## Validation

- 232 unit tests passed under Node 22.
- ESLint passed with no errors and five existing TODO warnings; Prettier and
  Stylelint checks passed.
- The release package built and its archives validated locally, including the
  new Credits compendium.
- The Foundry browser suite was not run for this release; it needs a licensed
  Foundry install that the automated sync cannot use.

## Installation

Paste this version-specific manifest URL into Foundry's system installer:

```text
https://github.com/sachamm/cyberpunk-red-foundry-v14/releases/download/v0.93.0-v14.alpha.4/system.json
```

Use this URL explicitly when upgrading from Alpha 3; GitHub's latest-release
download route does not select prereleases.

## Compatibility and limits

Foundry v14 only. The system ID remains `cyberpunk-red-core`, so it replaces
any system with that ID in the same data folder. Keep an untouched world backup
and test migrations in a separate Foundry data folder. Do not reopen migrated
worlds with an older system or Foundry version.

Legacy migration checks use historical fixtures. Genuine pre-v14 campaign
exports and third-party module combinations remain unverified. No browser
checks were run for this release. This is an alpha prerelease for testing.

## Downloads

- `system.json`: Foundry install manifest.
- `cyberpunk-red-core-0.93.0-v14.alpha.4.zip`: installable system.
- `cyberpunk-red-core-0.93.0-v14.alpha.4-source.zip`: corresponding GPL source.
- `SHA256SUMS`: SHA-256 checksums for those three files.
